_note: Example package. Offered as the example content of an empty library and written into a development installation by scripts/seed_demo.sh, so the core workflow can be tried against a realistic stock. Format as the export files. The German version is examples.de.json.

keywords.name: role
keywords.description: Gives the model an expert role
keywords.text: You are an experienced expert in this field.

keywords.name: context
keywords.description: Names where the text is published
keywords.text: The text appears in a specialist blog.

keywords.name: formal
keywords.text: Write in a factual, formal tone.

keywords.name: casual
keywords.text: Write casually and personally, without jargon.

keywords.name: brief
keywords.text: Keep it short, at most 150 words.

keywords.name: detailed
keywords.text: Work out every point and give the reasons for it.

keywords.name: examples
keywords.text: Give a concrete example for every point.

keywords.name: steps
keywords.description: Asks for a sequence of steps
keywords.text: Structure the answer as numbered steps.

keywords.name: sources
keywords.text: Name two sources at the end.

prompts.title: Blog post generator
prompts.description: Writes an SEO article on any topic
prompts.body:
Write a blog post about {{topic}} for {{audience}}.

The post should be {{length}} and answer the questions readers ask most.

prompts.title: Product description
prompts.description: Describes a product for an online shop
prompts.body:
Write a product description for {{product}}.

Highlight {{feature}} and address {{audience}}.

prompts.title: Newsletter opening
prompts.description: Opens a newsletter with a hook
prompts.body:
Write the opening of a newsletter about {{topic}}.

The hook is {{hook}}. The issue comes out on {{date}}.

prompts.title: Social media post
prompts.description: Short post for a social network
prompts.body:
Write a post for {{network}} about {{topic}}.

At most {{characters}} characters, with a fitting hashtag.

prompts.title: Press release
prompts.description: Announcement for the trade press
prompts.body:
Write a press release about {{occasion}}.

The company is {{company}}, the contact person is {{contact}}.

prompts.title: Landing page copy
prompts.description: Copy for a landing page with a clear call to action
prompts.body:
Write the copy of a landing page for {{offer}}.

The call to action is {{cta}}. Address {{audience}}.

prompts.title: Ad copy
prompts.description: Short advertising copy for an ad
prompts.body:
Write three versions of an ad for {{product}}.

Each version at most {{characters}} characters.

prompts.title: Subject line workshop
prompts.description: Comes up with subject lines for an email
prompts.body:
Suggest ten subject lines for an email about {{topic}}.

The recipients are {{recipients}}.

prompts.title: Content plan
prompts.description: Editorial plan for a period of time
prompts.body:
Draft an editorial plan for {{period}} with the focus {{focus}}.

One piece per week, with title, format and audience.

prompts.title: Find SEO keywords
prompts.description: Collects search terms for a topic
prompts.body:
List twenty search terms for {{topic}}, sorted by estimated search volume.

Mark the terms that show an intent to buy.

prompts.title: Friendly support reply
prompts.description: Draft reply to a customer request

prompts.title: Reply to a complaint
prompts.description: Reply to a complaint that calms things down

prompts.title: Decline politely
prompts.description: Turns down a request without putting people off
prompts.body:
Write a reply declining {{request}}.

The reason is {{reason}}. Offer {{alternative}} as an alternative.

prompts.title: Meeting request
prompts.description: Asks for an appointment
prompts.body:
Write a short message to {{recipient}} asking for a meeting about {{occasion}}.

Suggest {{slots}}.

prompts.title: Reminder of an unpaid invoice
prompts.description: Friendly payment reminder
prompts.body:
Write a payment reminder to {{recipient}} for invoice {{number}} of {{amount}} euros.

The invoice was due on {{due}}.

prompts.title: Write an FAQ entry
prompts.description: Phrases a question and its answer
prompts.body:
Write an FAQ entry for the question: {{question}}

The answer should be {{length}} and take {{note}} into account.

prompts.title: Conversation guide
prompts.description: Guide for a customer conversation
prompts.body:
Draft a guide for a conversation with {{partner}} about {{topic}}.

The goal of the conversation is {{goal}}.

prompts.title: Quote text
prompts.description: Text for a quote to a customer
prompts.body:
Write a quote for {{service}} to {{customer}}.

The price is {{price}} euros, the term {{term}}.

prompts.title: Code review checklist
prompts.description: Reviews a pull request in a structured way

prompts.title: Explain an error message
prompts.description: Explains an error message and names causes

prompts.title: Derive test cases
prompts.description: Derives test cases from a requirement

prompts.title: Commit message
prompts.description: Writes a commit message

prompts.title: Build an SQL query
prompts.description: Writes a query for a question
prompts.body:
Write an SQL query that answers {{question}}.

The tables are:
{{schema}}

The database system is {{system}}.

prompts.title: Suggest a refactoring
prompts.description: Suggests improvements to code

prompts.title: Document an API endpoint
prompts.description: Describes an endpoint

prompts.title: Explain a regular expression
prompts.description: Takes a regular expression apart

prompts.title: Migration plan
prompts.description: Plans the move to a new version
prompts.body:
Draft a plan for moving from {{old}} to {{new}}.

Name the order, the way back and the places where it can go wrong.

prompts.title: Read a log excerpt
prompts.description: Interprets a log excerpt

prompts.title: Naming suggestions
prompts.description: Finds names for classes, fields or services
prompts.body:
Suggest ten names for {{subject}}.

The language is {{language}}, the naming convention {{convention}}.

prompts.title: Summarise a text
prompts.description: Summarises a long text

prompts.title: Pros and cons
prompts.description: Sets the arguments of both sides against each other
prompts.body:
Set out the arguments for and against {{question}}.

Take the point of view of {{viewpoint}} into account.

prompts.title: Name the risks
prompts.description: Collects the risks of a project
prompts.body:
Name the risks of {{project}}.

Rate every risk by likelihood and impact.

prompts.title: Interpret figures
prompts.description: Explains a series of key figures

prompts.title: Comparison table
prompts.description: Compares several options
prompts.body:
Compare {{options}} by {{criteria}}.

Present the result as a table and give a recommendation.

prompts.title: Extract the key points
prompts.description: Pulls the key points out of a text
prompts.body:
Name the five key points of the following text:

{{text}}

prompts.title: Questions about a text
prompts.description: Produces follow-up questions about a text

prompts.title: Shorten a text
prompts.description: Shortens a text to a given length
prompts.body:
Shorten the following text to {{words}} words without losing any statement:

{{text}}

prompts.title: Change the tone
prompts.description: Rewrites a text in another tone
prompts.body:
Rewrite the following text in a {{tone}} tone:

{{text}}

prompts.title: Check spelling
prompts.description: Corrects a text
prompts.body:
Correct the spelling and punctuation of the following text and list the changes:

{{text}}

prompts.title: Translate
prompts.description: Translates a text

prompts.title: Plain language
prompts.description: Rewrites a text in plain language

prompts.title: Draft an outline
prompts.description: Drafts the outline of a text
prompts.body:
Draft an outline for a text about {{topic}} with {{chapters}} chapters.

The readers are {{audience}}.

prompts.title: Title suggestions
prompts.description: Finds titles for a text
prompts.body:
Suggest ten titles for a text about {{topic}}.

Three factual, three that make people curious, four short ones.

prompts.title: Put a quote in context
prompts.description: Places a quote in its context

prompts.title: Meeting minutes
prompts.description: Turns notes into minutes

prompts.title: Derive a task list
prompts.description: Pulls the tasks out of a text

prompts.title: Agenda
prompts.description: Drafts an agenda
prompts.body:
Draft an agenda for a meeting about {{topic}}.

Duration: {{duration}} minutes, participants: {{participants}}.

prompts.title: Decision paper
prompts.description: Prepares a decision
prompts.body:
Prepare a decision on {{question}}.

Name the situation, the options, a recommendation and the consequences.

prompts.title: Status report
prompts.description: Sums up the state of a project
prompts.body:
Write a status report on {{project}}.

State: {{state}}. Next steps: {{next}}.

prompts.title: Onboarding plan
prompts.description: Plans the first weeks of a new person
prompts.body:
Draft an onboarding plan for {{role}} over {{weeks}} weeks.

The team is {{team}}.

prompts.title: Prepare a retrospective
prompts.description: Prepares a look back
prompts.body:
Prepare a retrospective on {{period}}.

Ask about what went well, what did not, and what should change.

prompts.title: Compte rendu d'entretien
prompts.description: Résume un entretien en points clairs, en français
prompts.body:
Rédige le compte rendu de l'entretien avec {{prénom}} au sujet de {{sujet}}.

Garde au cœur du texte ce qui a été décidé : les points d'accord, les questions restées ouvertes et la prochaine échéance. Cite les phrases importantes entre « guillemets ».

prompts.title: Descrizione di una città
prompts.description: Presenta una città per un testo di viaggio, in italiano
prompts.body:
Descrivi {{città}} per un lettore che non c'è mai stato.

Comincia da ciò che si vede per primo, poi passa a ciò che si sente: il ritmo delle strade, i caffè, la luce della sera. Chiudi con {{numero}} motivi per andarci davvero.

prompts.title: Balance del año
prompts.description: Repasa un año de trabajo y saca conclusiones, en español
prompts.body:
Haz el balance del año {{año}} para {{equipo}}.

¿Qué salió bien y qué no? ¡Sé concreto! Nombra tres logros, tres cosas que costaron más de lo previsto, y una que el año que viene se hará de otra manera.

prompts.title: Release notes from a changelog
prompts.description: Turns a raw changelog into notes people actually read, in English
prompts.body:
Turn the changelog below into release notes for {{audience}}.

Lead with what changed for them, not with what changed in the code. Group the entries, drop everything that is invisible from the outside, and keep it under {{limit}} lines.

Changelog:
{{changelog}}
